content_blocks.label: clause_1._NOTICE_OF_VIOLATION
content_blocks.text: You are hereby notified that you have violated the terms of your lease agreement by failing to maintain the cleanliness of the premises.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_TIME_FOR_REMEDY
content_blocks.text: You have thirty (30) days from the receipt of this notice to remedy the violation and restore the premises to their original condition.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._FAILURE_TO_REMEDY
content_blocks.text: If the violation is not remedied within the specified time, this notice constitutes a formal demand for possession of the premises.
